content.rationale: The module set is flat files under `src/` (M-layout), declared once here, so the crate root is the one place the tree is named. `src/lib.rs` names every module, holds the verb table — one row per verb, each row pointing at the verb's own handler, the single enumeration the dispatcher and the bare list read, so no module carries a second copy — and exposes the assembled entry: resolve the substrate's handles once (M-context-injection) and hand the table and the context to the envelope, returning its status. `src/main.rs` is the thin `fn main` that calls that entry, so the path a test drives is the path production runs. The committed `Cargo.lock` pins the resolved dependency set the manifest declares and names the package the same (M-name); it is generated here, where the crate's targets first exist. The package name M-name fixes makes the library target `deccy_cli`, the path `src/main.rs` calls. The entry resolves the substrate's handles before the envelope (M-context-injection), so resolution is total (S3-root-optional), so a root-less context is a state and the init verb runs on it; a genuinely failing resolution is handed back to the envelope as a refusal (M-resolution-failure), and the globals are not exempt from resolution (M-globals-context). An unreadable working directory is not fatal: `"."` stands in (M-cwd-fallback), so the read stays total and a genuine failure still surfaces as a refusal. `src/jj_init.rs` (M-jj-init) and `src/verb_init.rs` (M-init) join the module set, and the table gains the `init` row first — one row per verb, so adding init touches nothing else (D23). The map names every module the crate root declares — M-store-read (tmwyqnyz) and M-jj-read (osplmlvq) among them. `src/divergence.rs` (M-jj-divergence, xoroywoy) joins the module set: the crate root declares it with the rest, so the verb modules reach the divergence read through one declared module. The refine adds the two draft verbs to the names this root owns. `src/draft_handle.rs`, `src/draft_identity.rs`, `src/draft_registry.rs`, `src/jj_workspace.rs`, `src/verb_draft.rs` and `src/verb_drafts.rs` join the module set, declared here beside the rest of the flat map, so the draft records and the workspace they open reach the verb modules through the one declaration this root already is. The table gains two rows appended after `redo` — `draft` pointing at `verb_draft::run` and `drafts` pointing at `verb_drafts::run` — so the bare list names eleven verbs in table order, each draft verb owns its handler instead of sharing one, and no pre-existing row changes (D23). Adding the two verbs is M-verb-draft (xulmunov) and M-verb-drafts (kpkplmqy) discharged at the crate root: the decision is unchanged in kind, so the same root that named the module set and held the single enumeration now names the draft modules and holds their two rows, and the modules are reachable only through it. The refine names one more module exactly once: the crate root declares `src/state_root.rs` in the same flat map that names every other module, so the resolver decision (xymxqnvz) joins the module set and `trunk_root` and `StateRootError` are reached as `deccy_cli::state_root` — the public path under the crate root — so the context no longer needs a nested copy of the resolver, and no consumer needs a `#[path]` shim of the file. The entry also exhausts the context's resolution failures: `context_reason` renders `ContextError::StateRoot` — the resolver's typed cause, through its own `Display` — and `ContextError::RootQuery` — the root query's reported reason — beside the missing-binary and spawn reasons already carried, so a context that cannot be resolved is handed back to the envelope as a refusal (M-resolution-failure, oqpxpkoo) on every path, with the raw reason kept as the refusal's text. The committed `Cargo.lock`'s `deccy-cli` entry is a stamping surface for the version token I0 records (the version decision, nlomlqum): it pins the same token the manifest names, so the lockfile, the manifest and the node agree. The refine also names the landed discard verb: the crate root declares `src/verb_discard.rs` in the same flat map that names every other module, so the discard handler (M-V-discard, trwtmzyq) joins the module set, and the table gains a twelfth row appended after `drafts` — `discard` pointing at `verb_discard::run` — so the assembled entry dispatches the verb and the bare help lists twelve verbs in table order, with no pre-existing row changed (D23).
